block.overpressure.filter_pipe.tooltip.s: A _Filter_ can be inserted into the pipe's filter slot.
overpressure.grind_rail.error.overlap: Rail section overlaps an existing section
overpressure.grind_rail.error.horizontal: Grind rails can only be built horizontally
overpressure.grind_rail.error.steep: The rail incline is too steep
overpressure.grind_rail.error.support_re: Grind rails can only connect to grind rail supports
overpressure.grind_rail.error.edge_occup: This support edge is already connected
overpressure.ponder.item_pump_required.t: Pneumatic tubes form a route, but do not create item flow on their own.
Install an Item Pump in the line to move items.
The pump requires a source of rotation.
Supply rotation to the pump's cogwheel to start the flow.
Flow speed depends on rotational speed.
The higher the rotational speed, the faster items move.
overpressure.ponder.valve.text_1: The Pneumatic Valve can shut off the item flow.
overpressure.ponder.valve.text_2: The valve is open by default.
overpressure.ponder.valve.text_3: Attach a Redstone Link to the valve to control it.
overpressure.ponder.valve.text_4: When it receives a signal, the valve closes and stops the flow.
overpressure.ponder.valve.text_5: When the signal is removed, the valve opens again.
overpressure.ponder.flow_sensor.text_1: The sensor monitors the state of the flow inside the tube.
overpressure.ponder.flow_sensor.text_2: The green indicator means that the line is operating normally.
overpressure.ponder.flow_sensor.text_3: If the route is blocked, a queue begins to build up before the obstruction.
overpressure.ponder.flow_sensor.text_4: When a clog is detected, the sensor lights its red indicator and emits a maximum-strength redstone signal.
overpressure.planning.title: Pneumatic Tube Planning
overpressure.planning.1: Tubes build in one go between two endpoints.
overpressure.planning.2: Corner tubes connect at an angle into one smooth tube.
overpressure.planning.3: Place a Pneumatic Connector and rotate it: arrow from
overpressure.planning.4: a chest extracts, arrow into a chest inserts.
overpressure.planning.5: Add an Item Pump to speed up item transport.
overpressure.ponder.curvature_tube.text_: A curved section is a visual shell and may have no collision in some places.
The actual path is formed by invisible tube blocks arranged at an angle.
The entire structure behaves as one continuous tube section.
overpressure.ponder.pneumatic_connection: Pneumatic connectors link a tube line to containers.
In extract mode, a connector sends items from the container into the tube.
In insert mode, a connector sends items from the tube into the container.
Use a Wrench to change the connector's orientation and operating mode.
A filter limits which items the connector may extract.
A redstone signal blocks the extractor; its illuminated outline shows that it is disabled.
Items already in transit continue moving to their destination.
overpressure.ponder.packagers.text_1: Pneumatic connectors link Create Packagers through a tube line.
overpressure.ponder.packagers.text_2: The sending Packager forms and seals a package.
overpressure.ponder.packagers.text_3: The pump moves packages through the tubes as pneumatic capsules.
overpressure.ponder.packagers.text_4: The receiving Packager opens arriving packages.
overpressure.ponder.item_pump.text_1: The line's throughput can be increased with a pump.
overpressure.ponder.item_pump.text_2: Replace one section of tube with a pump.
overpressure.ponder.item_pump.text_3: The pump requires rotation to operate.
overpressure.ponder.item_pump.text_4: Supply rotation to the pump's cogwheel.
overpressure.ponder.item_pump.text_5: Rotational speed determines the flow speed.
overpressure.ponder.item_pump.text_6: A higher rotational speed makes items move faster.
overpressure.ponder.filter_pipe.text_1: The Filtered Pneumatic Pipe separates matching blocks from the rest of the flow.
overpressure.ponder.filter_pipe.text_2: Insert an item or a configured Create Filter into the white filter slot.
overpressure.ponder.filter_pipe.text_3: Blocks that do not match the filter continue straight ahead.
overpressure.ponder.filter_pipe.text_4: Matching blocks are diverted into the curved branch.
overpressure.ponder.hand_port.text_1: The Capsule Port lets a player send items into a pneumatic network by hand.
overpressure.ponder.hand_port.text_2: Right-click the port with items to load them into its capsule.
overpressure.ponder.hand_port.text_3: A redstone signal seals the loaded items and dispatches the capsule through the network.
A Mechanical Arm can act as a router for packages entering the depot.
Put a Package Filter with an address into each destination connector.
The arm compares the box address and carries it to the matching connector.
Leave one connector unfiltered as the fallback route for boxes without an address.
The fallback also receives named boxes whose address matches none of the filtered outputs.
